_comment: A declared portfolio per horizon.
Nothing in this repository writes a `portfolios` or `positions` row, so the
operator states what each horizon holds and this file is the statement --
versionable, diffable, and honest about its own provenance. Reading holdings
from those empty tables would instead produce a confident plan for an empty
portfolio, which looks identical to a portfolio that genuinely holds nothing.
Every field is required. There is no default equity, cash, universe, as-of
date, holding stop, session count or score range, because each would decide
something material while appearing to decide nothing: a defaulted stop
invents the position's size, since risk-based sizing derives shares from the
entry-to-stop distance.
`as_of` is 2026-08-14, a session on which two names actually cross.
What this session demonstrates, and the reason the three horizons are never
collapsed: PG is REFUSED by Swing -- its sector is over the cap and the
portfolio is over its heat limit -- and BOUGHT by Retirement, which is flat
and has room for it. Same name, same day, opposite conclusions. A single
Buy/Sell number across horizons would destroy exactly that information.
MA is refused by Swing for heat alone and ranks above PG, because the fit
scores it higher (0.59 against 0.43) for sitting outside the crowded sector.
That is the portfolio fit doing the job it exists for.
Note how coarse SIC is: 20 of these 33 names are 'Manufacturing', AAPL, JNJ,
KO, CVX and CAT among them. The cap is real and so is the bluntness of the
bucket it is applied over.
Run it with:  tradeit plan --declaration docs/examples/portfolios.example.json

portfolios.note: Daily bars, mid-cycle: six positions, 51% invested. Marked at this session's closes the portfolio's heat is 6.28% -- just over the 6% limit, because open risk is measured from the current mark and not from entry -- so both names crossing today are refused, and the one in the over-weight sector carries a second veto. The trigger layer (H1/M15) needs intraday-01 and is absent.
Derivable from Daily and never run before. Starts flat, wider stop.
